task.subject: An issue-triage review workflow for the githubnext/gh-aw-cao repository
task.intent: Assess whether the issue-triage review workflow is activating on newly opened issues, producing bounded review outputs, and attaining its intended value of surfacing ready-to-triage issues with accepted evidence.
activationConditions: A repository operator enables a standalone issue-triage review workflow on githubnext/gh-aw-cao.
A newly opened issue in githubnext/gh-aw-cao creates one stable triage opportunity for the workflow.
A workflow run associated with that issue is observed in the dashboard horizon.
requiredEffects: For each eligible issue opportunity, the workflow evaluates the issue and emits at most one safe review output describing whether triage can proceed.
Accepted repository evidence must remain limited to the issue outcome, any linked finding, and the workflow run provenance for that same issue opportunity.
The workflow must leave ineligible, duplicate, or already-triaged issues without a new durable output.
noopConditions: The issue is already labeled as triaged or closed before the workflow evaluates it.
The issue lacks the minimum issue body or repository context needed for a bounded triage review.
A prior accepted workflow output already covers the same issue opportunity.
successConditions: The workflow activates for eligible issue opportunities within the selected horizon.
Observed outcomes for eligible opportunities are accepted or intentionally no-op with matching evidence strength and run provenance.
Mature operational-value observations show the direct triage-readiness attainment metric for the same issue opportunity.
uncertainties: A successful run does not by itself prove the durable issue outcome was accepted.
Pending or ignored safe outputs do not establish attained triage readiness.
Missing or interim operational-value evidence must remain distinct from zero attainment.

operationalValue.statement: Operational value is the share of stable new-issue triage opportunities that reach accepted triage-readiness outcomes with mature evidence for the issue-triage review workflow.
operationalValue.opportunity: One newly opened issue in githubnext/gh-aw-cao that is eligible for repository triage review.
operationalValue.opportunityKey: repository + issue opportunity represented by operational-case
acceptedEvidence: A workflow run for the issue-triage review workflow bound to the issue opportunity.
A safe-output outcome on the issue recording the triage review disposition.
An operational-value observation whose operational-case identifies the same issue opportunity and whose accepted-evidence-provenance names the accepted issue evidence.

metric.name: triage-readiness-attainment
metric.definition: 1 when the issue opportunity reaches an accepted triage-readiness outcome with mature evidence for the same operational case; 0 when the matured evidence shows the issue was not triage-ready or the accepted outcome was rejected, ignored, or absent by cutoff; null when required evidence has not matured.

operationalValue.maturation: An opportunity matures when the operational-value observation reaches maturity-status matured after the evidence-cutoff for the same operational case.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Assign 0 only when mature evidence for the issue opportunity shows triage readiness was not attained by cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Use null when the operational-value observation is absent, unavailable, or not yet matured for the issue opportunity; do not substitute 0.
